summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests ulixertinib in people with histiocytic neoplasms. Patients start ulixertinib at 300 mg twice daily, given in 28-day cycles; the total length of treatment is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated, but the study aims to find out whether ulixertinib is effective and safe.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa ulixertinib en personas con neoplasias histiocíticas. Los pacientes comienzan con ulixertinib a 300 mg dos veces al día, en ciclos de 28 días; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. La medida de resultado principal no se indica, pero el estudio busca saber si ulixertinib es eficaz y seguro.
who_for: Histiocytic neoplasm confirmed by pathology, with supporting radiologic or molecular findings
Mutation in a MAPK pathway gene for the primary group; not required for the exploratory group
Disease that can be measured on imaging, confirmed by a radiologist
Age 12 or older, with age limits that change after the interim analysis
Disease that is recurrent, refractory, or persistent after prior treatment, or multisystem disease, or single-system disease causing organ problems
not_for: Uncontrolled or severe other medical condition
Histiocytic neoplasm treatment within 28 days or 5 half-lives before the first dose
Disease that is meant for observation only or first-line local therapy
Inability to swallow tablets, a feeding tube, or prior stomach or duodenal surgery that may affect absorption
